title: [007] Install mdmedia from a tarball built inside studio

violation.problem: `mdmedia` points at `file:../mdmedia-0.1.0.tgz`, which is gitignored, absent, and outside `studio/`.
violation.expectedSolution: Add a `vendor:mdmedia` script that builds and packs the root package into `studio/vendor/`, and point the dependency there.
